claim_label: Prioritizing present-day algorithmic bias versus future existential risks
description: The contested issue is whether AI alignment efforts should prioritize mitigating immediate harms from algorithmic bias or preventing irreversible existential risks posed by future superintelligence.

instances.assertion: Argues we must focus on fixing built-in biases causing immediate harm, like discriminatory hiring and medical malpractice.
Argues that while present harms matter, preventing the irreversible existential risk of an unaligned superintelligence must be the top priority.
